pairs.target: dìsān zǎo , záhuòpù de mén zhī kāi le bànshàn .
pairs.english: On the third morning, only half the general store's doorway was open.
pairs.hanzi: 第三早，杂货铺的门只开了半扇。

pairs.target: xīnhuò zuówǎn yòu tiān le yìpī , pù zhǔ bǎ néng wǎng lǐ nuó de quán nuó guò , réng yǒu liǎngzhī xiāng zhàn zhe mén hòu .
pairs.english: Another batch of stock had arrived last night. The owner had moved everything possible inward, yet two crates still occupied the space behind the door.
pairs.hanzi: 新货昨晚又添了一批，铺主把能往里挪的全挪过，仍有两只箱占着门后。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài lǐmiàn , duì kàn lù nǚrén tān le tān shǒu , shuō jīnrì zài xiè lìng yíshàn , xiāngzǐ jiù dé bān dào guìtái shàng , zǒng bùnéng jiào lái mǎi yán de rén gé zhe huò hǎn .
pairs.english: Standing inside, he spread his hands to the passage woman: removing the other panel today meant putting crates on the counter, leaving salt buyers shouting over stock.
pairs.hanzi: 他站在里面，对看路女人摊了摊手，说今日再卸另一扇，箱子就得搬到柜台上，总不能叫来买盐的人隔着货喊。

pairs.target: chē hái zài cāng qián , méi guǎijìnlái . nǚrén ràng tā jìxù děng , zìjǐ cháo shū yàn zhāoshǒu .
pairs.english: The cart had not turned in and remained before the warehouses. The woman kept it waiting and beckoned Shuyan.
pairs.hanzi: 车还在仓前，没拐进来。女人让它继续等，自己朝舒砚招手。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòzài zuótiān de wèizhì , tīngjiàn bì lán jīngguò shí hēng yíduàn qǔzi , diàozi guǎi dé hěn gāo , dǎo bú xiàng yǎnqián yòu chū le máfán .
pairs.english: From yesterday's spot Tavi heard Bilan humming as she passed, the tune rising high, hardly suggesting another problem nearby.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐在昨天的位置，听见碧岚经过时哼一段曲子，调子拐得很高，倒不像眼前又出了麻烦。

pairs.target: shū yàn dào le méi jiào pù zhǔ zài ràng , zhī náchū qián rìjì de shíchén , tóng tā hé guò yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Shuyan arrived without asking the owner to yield more, only checking the previously recorded hours with him.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚到了没叫铺主再让，只拿出前日记的时辰，同他核过一遍。

pairs.target: sān zǎo de shìxíng bù děngyú lián diàn yě jiè zǒu sān zǎo ; zuórì shōugōng yǐhòu tiān de huò , běn jiù zài tā shuō guò yào yòng de nà yìbiān .
pairs.english: A three-morning trial did not mean borrowing the whole shop for three mornings; stock added after yesterday's work occupied the side he had said he needed.
pairs.hanzi: 三早的试行不等于连店也借走三早；昨日收工以后添的货，本就在他说过要用的那一边。

pairs.target: hè zhǎngguì gǎnlái , kànjiàn xiāngzǐ , xiān tàn le yìshēng , shuō zìjǐ cāng lǐ dǎo yǒu dìfāng , piānpiān dé cóng zhèlǐ zhuǎnguò qù cái dào .
pairs.english: Shopkeeper He hurried over, sighed at the crates, and said her warehouse had room, but carts had to turn here to reach it.
pairs.hanzi: 贺掌柜赶来，看见箱子，先叹了一声，说自己仓里倒有地方，偏偏得从这里转过去才到。

pairs.target: " nà ràng chē zài nàbiān děng , rén xiān bānjìn qù ? " kàn lù nánrén zhǐzhe cāng qián kòngdì .
pairs.english: “Then keep the cart waiting there and carry the goods in first?” The passage man pointed to the open warehouse forecourt.
pairs.hanzi: “那让车在那边等，人先搬进去？”看路男人指着仓前空地。

pairs.target: chēfū bùkěn , shuō zhī jià xiāng bùnéng láihuí tái . hè zhǎngguì kàn le zhuānghuò jìhào , wèn tā jīnrì zhēn yǒu zhī jià méiyǒu .
pairs.english: The driver refused: weaving-frame crates could not be carried back and forth. Shopkeeper He checked the cargo mark and asked whether he actually had one today.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫不肯，说织架箱不能来回抬。贺掌柜看了装货记号，问他今日真有织架没有。

pairs.target: tā lèng le yíxià , huítóu xiānkāi zhē bù , lǐmiàn shì jǐkǔn shōu hǎo de gān jūn , háiyǒu kōng mùxiāng .
pairs.english: He paused and lifted the cover: inside were bundles of packed dried mushrooms and empty wooden crates.
pairs.hanzi: 他愣了一下，回头掀开遮布，里面是几捆收好的干菌，还有空木箱。

pairs.target: mǎnjiē rén kànzhe tā , tā zìjǐ xiān xiào , shuō zhè liǎngrì tīng dé tài duō , huà bǐ nǎozǐ kuài .
pairs.english: With the whole street watching, he laughed first: he had heard it so often these days that his words outran his thoughts.
pairs.hanzi: 满街人看着他，他自己先笑，说这两日听得太多，话比脑子快。

pairs.target: jǐkǔn jūn gū biàn yóu cāng lǐ qǐnglái de liǎnggè rén xiān tái zǒu , chē tuìhuí děnghòu dì , shèngxià de shì bǐ gāngcái róngyì xǔduō .
pairs.english: Two workers hired by the warehouse carried the mushroom bundles first; the cart backed into the waiting area, making the rest much easier.
pairs.hanzi: 几捆菌菇便由仓里请来的两个人先抬走，车退回等候地，剩下的事比刚才容易许多。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi bǎ zhè xiěchéng dàchē dōu néng xiè . tā zài jìlù shàng fēnkāi xiāng huò hé kǔn huò , wèn chēfū jūn gū pàbupà lín ,
pairs.english: Tavi did not write that all big carts could unload. He separated boxed and bundled goods in his record and asked the driver if mushrooms could get wet,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没把这写成大车都能卸。他在记录上分开箱货和捆货，问车夫菌菇怕不怕淋，

pairs.target: chēfū jiào tā kànkàn wàitou bāo de yóubù , shuō zuì pà de dǎo shì mēn cháo , bié xiǎngzhe néng zài zhèlǐ fàngdào xiàgèyuè .
pairs.english: The driver pointed to the oiled wrapping: trapped damp was the real worry, no thinking they could sit here until next month.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫叫他看看外头包的油布，说最怕的倒是闷潮，别想着能在这里放到下个月。

pairs.target: dào wǔqián , tāmen bǎ sānzhāng jìlù tān zài chápéng . dìyī zǎo sìliàng , dìèr zǎo wǔliàng , jīnrì liùliàng lǐ yǒu liǎngliàng méi cóng ménqián zǒu , xiān huàn le bān fǎ .
pairs.english: By noon they spread three records in the tea shelter: four carts the first morning, five the second, and six today, two of which had used different handling rather than passing the doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 到午前，他们把三张记录摊在茶棚。第一早四辆，第二早五辆，今日六辆里有两辆没从门前走，先换了搬法。

pairs.target: ruò zhī xiě liùliàng quán guò , hè zhǎngguìde zhàngmiàn hǎokàn , lùkǒu què méi zhēn biànkuān .
pairs.english: Writing six all passed would flatter Shopkeeper He's accounts, but the junction had not really widened.
pairs.hanzi: 若只写六辆全过，贺掌柜的账面好看，路口却没真变宽。

pairs.target: tā jiāng nà liǎngliàng quān zài zìjǐ zhàng shàng , shuō fēnkāi jì , miǎnde xià huílái qīliàng hái jiào zìjǐ zhàobàn .
pairs.english: She circled the two in her accounts and said to record them separately, lest seven come next time and she be expected to do the same.
pairs.hanzi: 她将那两辆圈在自己账上，说分开记，免得下回来七辆还叫自己照办。

pairs.target: shū yàn qǐnglái de nǚrén zài pángbiān suàn gōngqián , suàn wán jiāng tóngqián yìméi méi lǒng jìn bùdài , wèn míngzǎo hái yòng bu yònglái .
pairs.english: Shuyan's hired woman calculated her pay nearby, gathered the coppers into a cloth bag one by one, and asked whether she was needed tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚请来的女人在旁边算工钱，算完将铜钱一枚枚拢进布袋，问明早还用不用来。

pairs.target: tā búshì lái tīng tāmen tán chángyuǎn de , ruò búyòng , biàn yào jiē biéchù de huó .
pairs.english: She was not there for long-term discussions; if not needed, she would take work elsewhere.
pairs.hanzi: 她不是来听他们谈长远的，若不用，便要接别处的活。

pairs.target: zuìhòu dìng de shì xiān bǎoliú cāng qián nà kuài děnghòu dì , yuànyì duǎn bān de kǔn huò lìng pái , búzài jiè záhuòpù zhěng shànmén ;
pairs.english: They agreed first to keep the warehouse waiting area and schedule bundled goods willing to be carried separately, no longer borrowing the shop's whole doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 最后定的是先保留仓前那块等候地，愿意短搬的捆货另排，不再借杂货铺整扇门；

pairs.target: cháng xiāng chē réng zhào shíjì chǐcùn lìng yuē , xià yìlún fàng jǐliàng , háiyào shū yàn tóng gèjiā héqīng .
pairs.english: Long-crate carts still needed individual arrangements by actual size; Shuyan and the households must confirm the next round's numbers.
pairs.hanzi: 长箱车仍照实际尺寸另约，下一轮放几辆，还要舒砚同各家核清。

pairs.target: kàn lù liǎng rén de xià yíduàn gōng , xiàwǔ zài míngshuō , bùnéng zhī liú yíjù " yǒushì zài jiào ".
pairs.english: The two passage workers' next engagement would be stated that afternoon, not left at “We'll call if needed.”
pairs.hanzi: 看路两人的下一段工，下午再明说，不能只留一句“有事再叫”。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shōu zhe zhǐ , xīnlǐ nà gǔ jǐnbēng sàn qù yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Gathering the papers, Tavi felt his tension ease a little.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维收着纸，心里那股紧绷散去一点。

pairs.target: tā méi pàn guò zìjǐ lái sān zǎojiù néng bǎ jiē biànkuān , kě kànzhe jǐgè quān bèi jiǎoyìn cǎi wāi , réng yǒuxiē shèbùdé bǎ tāmen zhī liúzài zhǐ shàng .
pairs.english: He had not expected three mornings to widen a street, yet seeing circles skewed by footprints, he disliked leaving them only on paper.
pairs.hanzi: 他没盼过自己来三早就能把街变宽，可看着几个圈被脚印踩歪，仍有些舍不得把它们只留在纸上。

pairs.target: wǔhòu huí kèzhàn , ruǎn héng bǎ yìfēng hé lù suǒ de lái zhǐ dìgěi tā .
pairs.english: Back at the inn that afternoon, Ruan Heng handed him a letter from the Joint Routes Office.
pairs.hanzi: 午后回客栈，阮衡把一封合路所的来纸递给他。

pairs.target: níng qí yào de liǎngmíng jià gōng hòu rì dào , lìng yìzhāng fù zhǐ quèshì bái jiē de hé kàn rìzi : bārì yǐhòu qǐ fēn sāntiān , tā pái zài dìyītiān , dé dài yuángǎo hé zìjǐ de liànxí jìlù .
pairs.english: Ningqi's two riggers were due the day after tomorrow. Another enclosure set White Steps reviews across three days starting in eight days; he was on the first and must bring originals and his practice records.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐要的两名架工后日到，另一张附纸却是白阶的核看日子：八日以后起分三天，他排在第一天，得带原稿和自己的练习记录。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shù dào yíbàn , ruǎn héng biàn shuō shì dìsì bǎi qī shíqīrì , búyòng jiāng zìjǐ shǒuzhǐ yě shù jìnqù .
pairs.english: Halfway through Tavi's counting, Ruan Heng said it was day four hundred seventy-seven; no need to count his own fingers in too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维数到一半，阮衡便说是第四百七十七日，不用将自己手指也数进去。

pairs.target: wǔtiān hòu dòngshēn , lùshang zhù yíyè , huíchéng háiyǒu yírì liúgěi jiālǐ .
pairs.english: They would leave in five days, stay one night on the road, and have a day for home after returning to the city.
pairs.hanzi: 五天后动身，路上住一夜，回城还有一日留给家里。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng yě yào huí suǒ lǐ jiàn rén , búshì sòng tā huíqù jiù lìkè zài zǒu , zhé tóng zhè yìtóu xiān yóu níng qí hé yù hé jiēzhe zuò .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng had office meetings too, not simply dropping him off and leaving again. Ningqi and Yuhe would continue the Zhetong work.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡也要回所里见人，不是送他回去就立刻再走，折桐这一头先由宁岐和郁禾接着做。

pairs.target: " hé kàn wán jiù huí zhèlǐ ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Back here after the review?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “核看完就回这里？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " hòutou de gōng dān hái méi dìng . nǐ ruò zhī xiǎng liú zhè tiáo jiē , wǒ hái dé wènwèn nǐ xiǎng buxiǎng . "
pairs.english: “The next work order isn't set. If it's only this street, I'd still have to ask whether you wanted to stay.”
pairs.hanzi: “后头的工单还没定。你若只想留这条街，我还得问问你想不想。”

pairs.target: tā yáotóu yáo dé hěnkuài , ruǎn héng xiào le yíxià , jiào tā biéjí , shíliù zhōu méi guò wán , yě búshì yìzhāng hé kàn zhǐ jiùsuàn xué wán le .
pairs.english: He shook his head quickly. Ruan Heng smiled and told him not to rush: sixteen weeks were not over, and one review paper did not finish his education.
pairs.hanzi: 他摇头摇得很快，阮衡笑了一下，叫他别急，十六周没过完，也不是一张核看纸就算学完了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zhǐ zhé hǎo , wǎnshàng xiān xiěgěi sè lā , gàosù tā nǎ tiān huíjiā , fùqián fàngjìn dài jì lán shí yòu mō le yíbiàn yī nèi nà zhāng jiù dàng hào .
pairs.english: Tavi folded the paper and that evening wrote to Sela with his homecoming date. Paying and putting it in the outgoing basket, he felt the old archive number inside his clothes again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将纸折好，晚上先写给瑟拉，告诉她哪天回家，付钱放进代寄篮时又摸了一遍衣内那张旧档号。

pairs.target: lóushàng níng qí zhèng wèn ā xún xīn jiàzi bǎizài nǎér , yuànlǐ háiyǒu méi gān de yīfu .
pairs.english: Upstairs Ningqi was asking Axun where to put the new stand; undried clothes still hung in the yard.
pairs.hanzi: 楼上宁岐正问阿荀新架子摆在哪儿，院里还有没干的衣服。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hūrán juéde zìjǐ yǒu liǎngtóu dōu mòshōu hǎo de dōngxī , què búzài xiàng chū dào bái jiē shí , zhǐyǒu yígèbāo , qù nǎér dōu bèizhe .
pairs.english: Tavi suddenly felt he had belongings unfinished at both ends now, unlike his first arrival at White Steps with only one bundle carried everywhere.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忽然觉得自己有两头都没收好的东西，却不再像初到白阶时，只有一个包，去哪儿都背着。
